result.conclusion: with 0x5B2C10 skipped the client never advances to phase 8, so there is no rebuilt cl2 to patch and the stub is never called. The temporary skip prevents the very window it was meant to protect.

lesson: the rebuild (0x4FE740: CL_Shutdown + CL_Init) and the 0x5B2C10 calls both happen at phase 8, and the rebuild comes first. Any patch to cl2+0x30 must therefore run at the end of CL_Init, not from outside the process between polls.
